statements.note: The abstract traces the CHRS family's origin from tRNA(Glu) in this common ancestor.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The tRNA(Glu)-derived SINEs are absent from the genomes of carnivores.
statements.evidence: a huge superfamily of tRNA(Glu)-related families of SINEs that are now found in the genomes of artiodactyls and cetaceans
statements.note: The abstract reports these SINEs in artiodactyls and cetaceans but says nothing about their presence or absence in carnivores.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In the Ruminantia lineage the Bov-tA SINE arose by recombination between the CHR-2 SINE and Bov-A.
statements.evidence: the Bov-tA SINE was generated by recombination between the CHR-2 SINE and Bov-A
statements.note: The abstract states Bov-tA formed by this recombination.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The distribution of a particular SINE family among artiodactyls and cetaceans confirmed paraphyly of the order Artiodactyla.
statements.evidence: The distribution of a particular family of SINEs among species of artiodactyls and cetaceans confirmed the most recent conclusion for paraphyly of the order Artiodactyla.
statements.note: The abstract reports the SINE distribution confirms Artiodactyla paraphyly.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The Brown Norway rat draft covers over 90% of the genome and is the third complete mammalian genome deciphered.
statements.evidence: a high-quality 'draft' covering over 90% of the genome. The BN rat sequence is the third complete mammalian genome to be deciphered
statements.note: The abstract reports over 90% coverage and the rat as the third mammalian genome.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Three-way comparisons with the human and mouse genomes resolve details of mammalian evolution.
statements.evidence: three-way comparisons with the human and mouse genomes resolve details of mammalian evolution
statements.note: The abstract states these three-way comparisons clarify mammalian evolution.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The rat genome is larger than the mouse genome.
statements.evidence: three-way comparisons with the human and mouse genomes resolve details of mammalian evolution
statements.note: The abstract makes three-way comparisons but never states the rat genome is larger or smaller than the mouse genome.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The analysis covered lineage-specific and lineage-independent events such as expansion of gene families and protein evolution.
statements.evidence: lineage-specific and lineage-independent evolutionary events such as expansion of gene families, orthology relations and protein evolution
statements.note: The abstract lists these evolutionary events including gene-family expansion.
